# Rocket Works Website

# This readme file has been autogenerated by claude#

Website for **Rocket Works**, the student rocketry society at Heriot-Watt University. Live at [hwrocket.works](https://hwrocket.works).

It is a static multi-page site built with [Vite](https://vite.dev/), Sass and vanilla JavaScript.

## Pages

| Page | File |
| --- | --- |
| Home | `index.html` |
| Subsystems | `pages/about.html` |
| Projects | `pages/projects.html` |
| Team | `pages/team.html` |
| Partners | `pages/partners.html` |
| Join us | `pages/joinus.html` |
| Contact | `pages/contact.html` |

## Tech stack

- [Vite](https://vite.dev/) for the dev server and production build
- [Sass](https://sass-lang.com/) for styling
- Vanilla JavaScript, with jQuery for some UI behaviour (scrolling, panels, parallax)
- [`vite-plugin-sitemap`](https://github.com/jbaubree/vite-plugin-sitemap) to generate `sitemap.xml`
- [cssnano](https://cssnano.github.io/cssnano/) for CSS minification in production builds
- [pnpm](https://pnpm.io/) as the package manager

## Getting started

### Prerequisites

- [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) (a current LTS release)
- [pnpm](https://pnpm.io/installation)

### Install and run

```bash
git clone https://github.com/hwrocketworks/hwrocketworks_website.git
cd hwrocketworks_website
pnpm install
pnpm dev
```

The dev server starts at <http://localhost:3000>.

### Scripts

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `pnpm dev` | Start the Vite dev server |
| `pnpm build` | Create a production build in `dist/` |
| `pnpm preview` | Serve the production build locally at <http://localhost:4173> |

## Environment variables

The Contact and Join Us forms submit to Google Apps Script endpoints. Create a `.env` file in the project root (it is git-ignored):

```env
VITE_GOOGLE_CONTACTUS_URL=<your contact form endpoint>
VITE_GOOGLE_JOINUS_URL=<your join us form endpoint>
```

Without these, the forms will not submit.

## Project structure

```text
.
├── index.html              # Home page
├── main.js                 # Entry point: page setup, forms, navigation, footer
├── vite.config.js          # Build config, path aliases, sitemap
├── pages/                  # Other HTML pages (about, contact, joinus, partners, projects, team)
├── public/                 # Static files copied as-is (robots.txt, favicons, team photos)
└── src/
    ├── assets/
    │   ├── images/         # Site images and icons
    │   ├── styles/         # Sass partials (base, components, layout, libs) and main.scss
    │   └── webfonts/       # Font Awesome webfonts
    ├── components/         # Shared navigation and footer
    ├── data/               # page-configs.js (per-page SEO metadata) and team data (JSON)
    └── js/                 # Form validators, parallax, scroll and panel helpers, team page logic
```

### Path aliases

Defined in `vite.config.js`: `@` (`src`), `@components`, `@assets`, `@styles`, `@images`, `@data`, `@js` and `@pages`.

## Common edits

- **Page title, description and canonical URL:** edit `src/data/page-configs.js`. Each page selects its entry through `data-page` on its `<body>` tag.
- **Team members:** edit `src/data/team.json` and add the member's photo to `public/images/`.
- **Styles:** edit the Sass partials in `src/assets/styles/` and `main.scss`.
- **Navigation and footer:** edit `src/components/navigation.js` and `src/components/footer.js`.

## Deployment

`pnpm build` outputs a static site to `dist/`, which can be hosted on any static host. The build also generates `sitemap.xml` for `https://hwrocket.works`.

## Contributing

1. Create a branch from `main`.
2. Make your changes and check them with `pnpm dev` and `pnpm build`.
3. Open a pull request.
